skill.name: bid-on-returning-customers
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to set up repeat purchase conversions for Google Ads, Meta, or ChatGPT Ads. Choose revenue or profit as the conversion value for retention campaigns.
skill.summary: Set up revenue or profit conversions for paid repeat purchases.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The confirmed static risks are authenticated access to a remote MCP service, order lookups, and an unpinned installer. No evidence of host reconnaissance or prompt injection was found. The workflow also lacks safeguards for credential entry, approval of Product Metrics writes, and the use of remote setup guidance.

remediation.issue: Credentials can pass through the assistant and CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Require credential entry in the authenticated integration UI or through a secret reference. Keep raw secrets out of chat, command arguments, and tool logs.

remediation.issue: Product Metrics writes do not have a general approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Start in read-only mode. Show the target store, ad account, and proposed changes, then request approval before connecting integrations or creating conversion actions.

remediation.issue: Remote content can direct authenticated setup operations.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed instructions and pin referenced skills to reviewed revisions. Treat live documentation as reference data and do not let it authorize tool calls.

remediation.issue: The remote MCP fallback can execute authenticated API operations.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the MCP origin and required permissions. Require explicit permission to connect and restrict tool execution to operations needed for the selected store.

remediation.issue: Order lookups expose individual transaction details.
remediation.suggestion: Use aggregate results for counts, limit records to the selected storefront, and omit customer details unless needed for a specifically requested lookup.
Pin the installer package version and the skill source revision. Document how to verify both before running the installer.

semantic_findings.title: Secrets Routed Through the Assistant
semantic_findings.description: The workflow permits asking for Lightspeed, Meta, or OpenAI credentials and passing them directly to a command. This can expose secrets through conversation history or tool arguments despite the instruction not to print or log them.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The credential exceptions and direct handoff are explicit, and no protected input mechanism is specified. No evidence of actual credential disclosure was found.

semantic_findings.title: Product Metrics Writes Lack Explicit Approval

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The approval boundary for final campaign settings is explicit. The write and setup instructions do not require equivalent approval for changes made through Product Metrics.

content.user_title: Set Up Bidding for Returning Customers
content.value_statement: General purchase conversions do not distinguish repeat orders from first purchases. Use Product Metrics to set up separate revenue or profit conversions for returning customer campaigns.
actual_capabilities: Explain how Product Metrics classifies paid orders as new, returning, or unknown.
Check setup status and identify remaining steps through the Product Metrics CLI or MCP.
Guide secondary conversion action setup in Google Ads and custom conversion setup in Meta or ChatGPT Ads.
Compare repeat order revenue with profit after product and additional costs.
Check recent orders for returning customer status and order margin.
Identify which campaign settings the user must change and check the resulting state.
limitations: Live checks require an authenticated Product Metrics connection. Without one, the skill can provide setup guidance.
The user must select campaign or ad set optimization goals and complete steps in the store admin.
Profit conversions require active additional cost settings and complete order cost data.
Unmatched orders do not count as returning. Cloudflare tracking cannot see purchases made before tracking began.

use_cases.title: Plan Repeat Purchase Tracking
use_cases.description: Find out which Shopify orders qualify for returning customer conversions before connecting Google Ads.

use_cases.title: Choose a Retention Campaign Goal
use_cases.description: Compare revenue and profit signals for a Meta ad set and identify the custom conversion to select.

use_cases.title: Check Repeat Order Classification
use_cases.description: Review recent orders in a selected storefront to verify repeat order classification and available margins.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Repeat Purchase Conversions
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain what counts as a returning customer conversion. Use an example with a first paid order, a repeat order, and an unmatched guest order.
prompt_templates.scenario: Learn the tracking rules without connecting an account.

prompt_templates.title: Check Google Ads Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the Product Metrics setup for my selected Shopify store and Google Ads account. List completed and remaining steps without making changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review an existing integration before campaign setup.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Meta Conversion Value
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare revenue and profit conversions for my WooCommerce Meta ad set. Identify the consent and cost requirements, then list the settings I must change myself.
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose a conversion value before adjusting a retention ad set.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a ChatGPT Ads Conversion
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether my selected store is connected to ChatGPT Ads. Compare the available repeat purchase events with my campaign goal. Report what I must verify in Ads Manager without changing any settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review conversion setup after a campaign change.

output_examples.input: What happens after a customer makes two paid purchases?
output_examples.output: The first paid purchase counts as new. The second counts as returning if Product Metrics can match it to the same customer.

output_examples.input: My Google Ads returning customer revenue action is secondary. What is left to do?
output_examples.output: The returning customer revenue action is ready for review. In Google Ads, select it as the goal for the intended retention campaign.

output_examples.input: Can I use the Meta profit conversion before my costs are complete?
output_examples.output: Use the revenue event for now. The profit event requires active additional cost settings and complete order costs.

best_practices: Confirm the store, ad account, and campaign before making any setup changes.
Verify the required consent settings before enabling conversion forwarding.
Check recent repeat orders and confirm the selected conversion after changing a campaign goal.
anti_patterns: Do not paste integration credentials into assistant chat. Use the authenticated integration settings.
Do not use both repeat order revenue and profit as goals for the same campaign.
Do not assume Cloudflare can classify purchases that it did not observe.

faq.question: Which stores and ad channels are supported?
faq.answer: Google Ads and Meta guides cover Shopify, WooCommerce, Lightspeed, Magento, Shopware, and Cloudflare sites. ChatGPT Ads uses a general setup guide.

faq.question: Does each repeat order count?
faq.answer: Yes. Each paid order after the first qualifies if Product Metrics can match it to the customer.

faq.question: What happens if Product Metrics cannot identify a customer?
faq.answer: The order can contribute to general revenue and profit tracking, but it does not count as new or returning.

faq.question: When can I use the profit conversion?
faq.answer: Use it after activating additional costs in Product Metrics and confirming that the order has complete cost data.

faq.question: Can the assistant change what my campaign bids on?
faq.answer: No. You choose the primary action in Google Ads or the optimization conversion in Meta or ChatGPT Ads.

faq.question: Do refunds update returning customer conversions?
faq.answer: Product Metrics adjusts Google Ads conversions for refunds and cancellations. Later refunds do not change the original Meta event.
